purpose: Pin a reproducible CNN/DailyMail source artifact and deterministic context-selection/segmentation procedure for Stage-3 paper-level reproduction.

paper_basis.paper: Ziegler et al. (2019), Neural Linguistic Steganography
paper_basis.paper_rule: Use the first three sentences of each CNN/DailyMail news article as context and generate one sentence from a uniformly random message.
paper_basis.split_note: The paper does not name a CNN/DailyMail split. Stage 3 therefore pins the standard test split as a predeclared operationalization; this choice must not be presented as the exact original split.

dataset.version_note: CNN/DailyMail 3.0.0 is the cased, non-anonymized summarization representation available as an immutable Parquet artifact. This is a reproducible modern artifact, not a claim that the 2019 authors used this exact Hub revision.

context_extraction.normalization: strip leading/trailing whitespace; collapse internal Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space; preserve case and punctuation; no lowercasing
context_extraction.boundary_rule: Split after terminal . ! ? (optionally followed by closing quotes/brackets) before whitespace and a plausible next-sentence starter, while protecting a frozen abbreviation/initial/decimal set.
context_extraction.minimum_note: At least four sentences are required so the first three can be context and a human-written next sentence remains available for later diagnostics.

selection.scan_policy: Scan ranked rows and accept the first 80 rows that satisfy the extraction validity rule.
selection.pilot_policy: first 8 accepted contexts in selection rank order

commit_policy.reason: The repository commits provenance, row/article identifiers, and hashes. Article/context text is regenerated locally from the pinned public artifact rather than copied into Git.

paper_matrix.note: The frozen Stage-3 parameter matrix is not modified by this dataset-pinning step.
